paragraphs: The provider records the accessible wall face and bracket penetrations separately; the material behind locked or loaded compartments stays outside confirmed findings until the client releases them.

Affected porous board is removed and collected where the licensed provider determines it cannot be suitably cleaned; compatible masonry or sound framing receives separate cleaning. The cold-wall condition is documented as a separate source question, not a cause conclusion.

sections.heading: Source responsibilities and repair prerequisites
paragraphs: The property’s authorized locker contact supplies compartment release and parcel custody separately from wall treatment. The provider’s exposed bracket and board record goes to the repair installer, with a locked span still excluded from confirmed inspection. Exterior-wall or moisture-source findings remain with the appropriate building contact rather than inferred from a single dark mark.

sections.heading: Client findings and approved resident notices
paragraphs: We send the exposed wall boundary and blocked compartment list to the designated manager. The hiring client’s approved resident notice names mailroom access limits, parcel handling under client direction and any alternate retrieval location the client designates. Scope decisions, approvals and progress remain directed to the designated client.

paragraphs: While Go Green’s Texas mold remediation license application is pending, work requiring a license is referred to appropriately licensed partner companies. The provider and scope are identified before work begins. Independent assessment or clearance is separate from remediation and is coordinated where required.

Porous backing affected beyond suitable cleaning is removed and collected within the provider’s documented opening; compatible tile and sound framing receive a specified retained-cleaning method. The plumber or qualified bath contractor addresses the pan or drain source.

sections.heading: Source responsibilities and repair prerequisites

The tile installer receives exposed cement-board and framing dispositions before reinstating the joint, while backing beneath an intact pan flange remains unexamined.
